Game Overview

At its heart, Survival Monk is a animal game about guide a nimble monkey through a perilous jungle, collecting bananas and dodging obstacles with intuitive controls. Each jump poses a thrilling challenge as the game’s difficulty evolves. With captivating gameplay and stunning graphics, Survival Monk offers an addictive arcade experience that keeps you coming back for more.
